children: US private prison operator's Q3 revenue rose 28% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 more than doubled but missed analyst expectations
Company executed $500 mln share buyback and expanded authorization by another $500 mln
Company now sees 2026 net income of $1.461 bln to $1.467 bln, down from prior view
Company raises 2026 adjusted net income forecast to $165 mln-$171 mln from $157 mln-$165 mln
Company says 2026 guidance does not include impact of potential additional facility sales
OCCUPANCY GAINS - Co said increased demand from ICE and higher utilization of recently activated facilities drove results
ASSET SALES - Co said sale of four detention facilities to the federal government generated significant gains
DEBT REPAYMENT & BUYBACK - Lower interest expense from debt repayment and reduced share count from buybacks boosted per-share earnings
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the business support services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for CoreCivic, Inc. is $42.00, about 35.6% above its November 3 closing price of $30.97
The stock recently traded at 6 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 16 three months ago
Nov 3 - Midterms may heighten focus on insurance affordability
